objective: Reduce the pendant-line statement, through ticket A's rule, to a local implication: whenever every crossing knot off the new point is reached, so is every crossing knot through it. Verify the implication on every local configuration (the gluing line, the line's two points, one more class and the far configurations), or report the first counterexample.
status: Proved by PENDANT-LINE-20261106-001B-P001: one new point on one new not-all-equal line through two points of a near side (any signs, the points on or off the gluing line) never adds creation: if the near side has no new knot of up to three points at a gluing line and far side, neither does the new one; with the no-loss half, creation is unchanged; proved from ticket A's two-round rule by an exhaustive local check (347,149,320 configurations, none a counterexample)
title: One new line never adds creation
